messages:
Linda: Heads-up — product is proposing we defer per-tenant quotas (billing + soft-limits) out of MVP and ship a lightweight 'routing guardrail' instead. Proposal: global soft quota + fallback routing now; full per-tenant quotas in v1. Thoughts? cc @Aj @Sophia
Aj: I agree in principle. Per-tenant quotas is an ent-level piece. What's the user-visible risk here? SLA/costing impact?
Sophia: Main risk is noisy tenants causing cost/SLO issues for other customers. Mitigation: rate-limiting headers, loud telemetry, and an elevated alert runbook.
Luca: If we defer we need a clear upgrade/rollback path. Can't leave customers exposed to unpredictable bills. Suggest we add tenant-tagging telemetry and a daily job that surfaces top noisy tenants.
Mina: Ops + CS are OK with deferring if we ship these guardrails: 1) per-request token cap enforced, 2) alert playbook for noisy tenants, and 3) customer comms.
Alex: Timeline impact: moving per-tenant quotas to v1 saves ~3 sprints. That narrows v1 scope. Are any Dedicated customers requiring per-tenant quotas now?
Linda: Two pilots asked for it: Acme (contractually required) and BetaCo (negotiable). Proposed compromise for Acme: Dedicated + opt-in per-tenant config (short-term).
Sophia: For Acme avoid custom infra if possible. Maybe contractual carveout: Dedicated + config flag, but mark as non-default and document risks.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy to staging of 'global-quota' feature completed at commit abc123
Aj: Drafting acceptance criteria for the MVP change. Propose: 1) Global soft quota applied per-account, 2) Telemetry surfaces top-5 noisy tenants daily, 3) CS runbook + alerts, 4) Opt-in dedicated flag for Acme with documented caveats.
Linda: Agree. I'll create a new milestone 'MVP: Guardrails' and update roadmap. I'll flag affected stories for reprioritization. @product-ops please update the release notes draft.
Mina: I'll own CS comms and the playbook. Need an engineering doc with examples and alert definitions.
Luca: I'll add the telemetry task and build a heatmap dashboard. Will pair with Mina.
Sophia: Calling out operational risk: this will be more manual for Acme initially. Recommend a 90-day follow-up to finish per-tenant quotas in v1 (or earlier if usage spikes).
Linda: :thumbsup: Can we get a quick decision by EOD so sprint planning can adjust?
Aj: Decision by EOD: defer per-tenant quotas to v1; ship guardrails + dedicated opt-in for Acme. I'll update JIRA labels and move stories. Assigning: ENG-4307 (telemetry) -> Luca, ENG-4308 (global quota) -> Taylor, ENG-4312 (dedicated opt-in) -> DevOps.
Taylor: Acknowledged. ETA ~2 sprints for the global quota feature. I'll scope minimal infra changes to hit that.
Mina: Thanks — I'll draft the CS comms and send for review.
Linda: Closing thread — I'll post the milestone update in the roadmap doc and ping PMs on any downstream impacts.
